plugins.name: ai-overmind
plugins.description: Build and run a personal AI team in Claude Code. Type /engage and your Overmind learns your role, proposes a custom team of AI specialists, and builds a boot layer and folder for each one. Handoffs, dispatch, a mission board, and a turn hook that reports what changed before every message.
